# PPT Studio for DeepSeek Harness

A left-sidebar **PPT workbench** plugin for DeepSeek Harness:
it renders `<workspace>/.ppt-studio/de

ck.json` as real 16:9 thumbnails, lets you edit the deck
**in place** (click a slide's text, type, c

lick away to save), imports existing `.pptx` files
**as they are** instead of re-flowing them into t

emplate layouts, and hosts a continuous AI chat
column that can rewrite the deck for you.

Everything you see above runs on the synthetic demo deck in `examples/demo-deck.json`
— no real pres

entation content is used in these screenshots. Copy it to `<workspace>/.ppt-studio/deck.json`
to try
the panel without touching your own deck.
中文说明见 README.zh-CN.md。
## What it does

- **Live 16:9 preview** — thumbnails and the big preview are real DOM renders of `deck.json`
(absolu

te element positions in inches on a 13.333 × 7.5 canvas), not screenshots.
- **Edit the way you see

it** — click a text block (or a table cell) right on the slide, type,
click elsewhere to save. The e

ditor keeps the original font size, weight, alignment and colour.
- **PPTX import, not PPTX re-types

etting** — `/import` runs a python-pptx importer that copies
every page element by element: absolute

geometry, font sizes, colours resolved from theme XML
(including `lumMod`/`lumOff`/`tint`/`shade`),

gradients with per-stop transparency, rounded
corners and ellipses, pictures deduplicated by conten

t hash, tables, group transforms, and the
decorations that live on the slide master / layout.
- **Ch

arts and SmartArt never disappear** — pages containing chart, SmartArt or OLE objects are
rendered w

holesale through LibreOffice → PDF → PNG and embedded as one full-bleed image, so
fidelity is 100% (

those pages are read-only by design).
- **AI chat column** — the middle column talks to the current

session: Markdown rendering,
attachments (paste / drag / picker) dropped into `.ppt-studio/inbox`, a

live "process" tab
showing tool calls with durations, and one-click prompts.
- **File watching that

respects you** — the panel polls `deck.json`; external edits highlight the
changed page, but the pa

nel's own saves are never flagged as "AI changed this".
- **One proportional splitter** fills the pa
ge and keeps both halves usable at any window size.
### Editing, metrics and imported tables
| Click any text block (or table cell) and type — click away to save. | Mixed run sizes (`spans`) an
d rounded shapes survive the PPTX import. |
| Tables are first-class elements, editable cell by cell. | Section pages keep their gradients and t
first-class elements, editable cell by cell. | Section pages keep their gradients and typography. |
## Install

The plugin ships as a single tarball with no runtime npm dependencies (the importer needs
Python 3 w
ith `python-pptx`, and optionally LibreOffice + poppler for chart pages).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install the tarball you built locally:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the app once after the first install. The sidebar then shows **PPT 工作台**.
### Python requirements for `.pptx` import

`python-pptx` and `lxml` are required; `LibreOffice` + `pdftoppm` (poppler) are optional and only
us

ed to rasterize chart/SmartArt pages. The plugin looks for an interpreter in this order:
`DSH_PPT_PY

THON` env var → the runtime bundled with the desktop app → `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes` →
`python` / `pytho
n3` / `py` on `PATH`.
## Quick start

1. Open a workspace that contains a deck (`.ppt-studio/deck.json`), or click **新建示例文稿**.
2. Click an

y text on the slide to edit it; `Esc` cancels, clicking elsewhere saves.
3. Drop a `.pptx` into the

chat column and press **导入** on the attachment chip to replace the
deck with an element-faithful imp

ort.
4. Ask the chat column for changes; it can rewrite `deck.json` directly.
## Deck format (`deck.json`)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Coordinates are inches on a 13.333 × 7.5 canvas; the renderer converts them to percentage
positions
and font sizes to `cqw`, so a slide scales exactly with its container.
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Host routes: `/health`, `/state`, `/session`, `/sessions`, `/answer`, `/cancel`, `/report`,
`/diag`,

`/upload`, `/import`, `/deck` (PUT), `/asset` (GET). They refuse non-loopback peers and
resolve eve
ry workspace path through the same guard as the rest of the panel.

The client half registers two slots: a `sidebar.panellist` entry (id `ppt-studio`) and a `main`
page

(key `ppt-studio`). It talks to the host half over the routes above and to the session
through the
Harness session binding.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dev-live-*.mjs` scripts drive a running desktop app over the Chrome DevTools Protocol
(port 9222) f
or visual checks; they expect a Chinese Windows workspace and are development-only.
## Known limitations

- No shadows, glows, 3-D, rotation, WordArt or animations — shapes are drawn as rectangles,
rounded

rectangles, ellipses or gradients.
- One text box can hold mixed run styles (`spans`), but editing a

box in place flattens it to the
base style.
- 4:3 decks are scaled into the 16:9 canvas.
- Chart /

SmartArt / OLE pages are images (read-only).
- Re-importing a `.pptx` overwrites in-panel edits, bec
ause the source of truth is the file.
## Feedback

- **Bug?** Open an issue — the
forms ask for the plugin build id, OS and a repro. Please redact pers

onal or confidential slide
content; `examples/demo-deck.json` reproduces most panel bugs.
- **Import

looks wrong?** Use the *PPTX import fidelity issue* form: it asks what the page is built
from (them

e fill, group, gradient overlay, chart, ...), which is usually enough to fix it.
- **Question / setu

p help?** Discussions → Q&A;.
- **Pull requests are welcome** — run `npm test` and `python scripts/s

elftest-import.py` first; the
repository also carries `examples/demo-deck.json` so screenshots and r
epros never need a real deck.
